generatedBy: frozen by the worker BEFORE any reproduction run (docs/mvp/phases/PHASE3-SPEC.md section 3)
rule: A reproduced trial matches the original when |new - original| <= reproductionTolerance on the primary metric, per (arm, seed). The tolerance is ABSOLUTE, not relative: the primary metric is a cross-entropy on a frozen 8-sample validation split, so a relative band would divide by a value that sits near 0.7 and silently widen the band as the metric shrinks.
rationale: The runner is deterministic on this profile (torch.use_deterministic_algorithms, single thread, pinned seed, pinned weights), so a correct reproduction should land within floating-point noise; 0.02 is deliberately wider than that noise so the check can catch a real environment drift rather than fire on rounding.

0.02 is roughly 2.8% of the observed baseline validation_loss (0.71248) and an order of magnitude tighter than the arm-to-arm differences this pilot measures, so a reproduction that lands inside the band cannot be mistaken for a performance result.
The tolerance is NOT widened after a number is seen. A reproduction that lands outside it stays failed; re-running with a looser band is a new protocol version, not a retry.
appliesTo: primaryMetricId only; secondary metrics are reported, not gated
notAToleranceFor: mechanism-check bounds (configs/phase2/tolerances.json) — those bound a probe's assertions, not a run-to-run delta
cross-machine reproducibility — the environment pin in fixtures/phase2-source-pack/environment.json is single-host
